boot_rollback.evidence: Corrupted one byte inside the active 0x920000 OTA app (offset 0x928000); the next boot logged 'OTA app partition slot 0 is not bootable' and loaded the factory application at 0x10000 instead, leaving otadata untouched. The sector and the whole slot were then restored byte-identically (True).

device_identity.evidence: ESP32-S3 native USB-Serial/JTAG MAC 14c19fd184f8 read on every write session; get_security_info chip_id 9, flags 0, flash_crypt_cnt 0 (no secure boot or flash encryption).

flash_identity.evidence: Flash JEDEC 0x18405E (16 MiB) and MD5 of the whole 16 MiB verified before each write; partition table matches folio-16m-factory-storage-ota-v2 (factory 0x10000, storage 0x410000, otadata 0x910000, ota_0 0x920000, ota_1 0xC20000).

font_fallback.evidence: Switched the built-in font 内置宋体 -> Folio 黑体 and back on hardware; font_active_id followed each selection, pages re-rendered, and the requested font was restored to songti afterwards.

nvs_storage_preserved.evidence: Full 16 MiB readback after the signed four-part write: NVS/PHY 0x9000-0xE000 and the 5 MiB storage/font area 0x410000-0x910000 are byte-identical to the pre-write backup 1b5514e4f860b5e8; the same comparison after the OTA install kept both regions and the inactive OTA slot unchanged.

ota_reject_invalid.evidence: A tampered image is refused on the device: the bootloader rejected the corrupted ota_0 slot (device log 'OTA app partition slot 0 is not bootable') and booted the factory application, while the signed download path refused incomplete bodies and length mismatches before any slot write. Host suites reject all 100 single-bit mutations and 99 hostile manifests. The local TF-card package path was not exercised in this session.

ota_signed_upgrade.evidence: Preview channel 0.8.38 (sequence 8038999, 2968144 B, sha256 7d9b53ebcae94c9d) verified by the device against the pinned P-256 key, downloaded to the TF card, then installed over 0.8.38-dev; otadata moved to ota_0, the slot descriptor reports 0.8.38 and the installed image SHA-256 equals the signed manifest.

physical_display.evidence: Reviewer waived the separate visual ghosting and contrast inspection for this release; the panel was driven through library, reader, tool menu and home with completed refreshes and captured framebuffer content matching every intended page.

reading_smoke.evidence: Scenario run 20261116-013054-reading: library -> open book -> next page -> tool menu -> back all reached the expected views with frame captures on each step; pagination advanced 7/8 -> 8/8 and the reading position was kept in the catalog after returning home.

thermal_stability.evidence: Panel driver reported 23-25 C across the session including the multi-minute OTA writes; no thermal warning, brownout or watchdog reset appeared in the device log during the install.

usb_four_parts.evidence: Signed usb.json for 0.8.38 (sequence 8038999) re-verified against the pinned key, then written: 0x0 bootloader.bin 21232 B, 0x8000 partition-table.bin 3072 B, 0x10000 folio.bin 2968144 B, 0x910000 ota_data_initial.bin 8192 B. Every part read back byte-identical; NVS/PHY 0x9000-0xE000, the 5 MiB font area and both untouched regions compared equal to the fresh 16 MiB backup 1b5514e4f860b5e8.
